			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = wanua_rice_barter_4
			aub_can_upgrade_to_wanua_rice_barter_5_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = wanua_rice_barter_4
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = wanua_rice_barter_5 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
}

# wanua_salt_barter_1: 4 frozen upgrade edge(s)
